start: ReasonIF is not evaluated, because its questions overlap with the sources of s1K.
text: ReasonIF is not evaluated, because s1K contains ReasonIF's sources: 4 of the 300 ReasonIF questions appear verbatim among the s1K questions (1 among the 212 used) and 37 share an 8-gram with one (24 with the 212), mostly AIME and AMC problems.
